title: Bite-sized embeddings + rerank mini-tour: compact pipeline diagrams and annotated sample cards
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Create a compact, mobile-first set of UX assets and annotated screenshots that teach engineers and PMs the end-to-end embeddings + rerank pipeline in under 90 seconds. Deliver a single Figma source file, four annotated screens (hero quickstart, pipeline explainer, sample outputs with scoring badges, error/fallback state), an SVG compact pipeline diagram optimized for docs banners, and a library of copy/snippets for the docs quickstart. Focus on clarity for first-time integrators and on-call SREs who need to understand fallback behavior.
deliverables: Sample API response cards (3 variants: ideal, partial match, fallback)
Accessible alt-text and copy snippets for docs and SDK quickstarts
sample_outputs: Top match: Document A — score 0.92 — rerank delta +0.12
Partial match: Document C — score 0.68 — suggested fallback to expanded query
Fallback: Embedding cache miss — policy: synchronous re-embed -> return top-N from local LRU
notes: Target voice: concise, engineer-focused, avoid sales language. Use consistent scoring badges (green >0.85, amber 0.6-0.85, red <0.6). Diagram must show where caching, batching, and rerank models sit in the request path. Include a one-sentence SLO note about expected added latency for rerank stage.
acceptance_criteria: 1) Figma file checked into /Design/Embeddings with components named consistently; 2) All 4 annotated screens exported in both desktop and mobile sizes and uploaded to Drive; 3) SVG pipeline validated in docs CDN and renders clearly at 320px width; 4) Copy snippets reviewed by PM and Engineering and linked in the PR; 5) Accessibility check: alt text for each image + color contrast passes AA

SVG pipeline retains legible labels at 320px width

handoff: Handoff package should include Figma link, exported PNGs and SVG, a short recording (90s) walking through screens, and a small MD file with copy snippets for the docs engineer to paste into the quickstart.
final_notes: Aim for a compact experience that can slot into the existing embeddings quickstart without increasing page length. If scope is tight, prioritize the pipeline SVG + two sample output cards over additional micro-interactions. Post-release: gather metrics on 'quickstart completion' and developer confusion flags in the docs feedback widget for iteration.
